title: Document numbering
subtitle: Set the running-number format of each document type. A document gets its number only when it is issued, and an issued number is never reused.
previewHint: "Next number" is what a document issued today would get; nothing is reserved.
readOnly: You can view only. Only members who manage the company can change these settings.
loadFailed: Could not load the numbering settings
lockedHint: Numbers were already issued in this period, so the format can change from the next period.
invalid: The pattern is not valid yet
patternHint: Click a tag to add it: '{prefix}' prefix, '{yyyy}' 4-digit year, '{yy}' 2-digit year, '{mm}' month, '{seq:4}' running number of 4 digits (3–6)

problems.seq_repeated: Use the running number '{seq:N}' only once
problems.unknown_token: There is an unknown token or a stray brace
problems.year_required: Yearly or monthly numbering needs a year: '{yyyy}' or '{yy}'
problems.too_long: The pattern is longer than 64 characters
